parts.title: Don't Kill The Ants! Here's Why #Shorts
parts.description:
Ants, flies, earthworms, millipedes and woodlice are detritivores: they help break down dead things. Leave them alone! Plus: compost and recycle for less ash at Pulau Semakau. Watch the full episode: Dead things become your food?! (TheOneApp, Explored EP10)

TheOneApp, Explored: one real news story every Thursday, and the science from your textbook (Primary 3 to Primary 6, Singapore). The sister series of TheOneApp, Explained.
